_comment: Parts placed by function, not by connection length, or over a datasheet budget for a measured reason. placeaudit.py and dsgap.py report them as KEEP with this reason. Every reason was checked on the board (cp5 master f9fb559366, 2026-10-04). Edit freely.
U302: TMP117: measures the board temperature at the RF / analog section (drift checks), so it sits there on purpose
RN801: LCD bus series source termination: belongs at U401 (source end)
RN802: LCD bus series source termination: belongs at U401 (source end)
RN803: LCD control series source termination: belongs at U401 (source end)
R804: LCD_DC series source termination at the driver (5.3 mm from U401.5), like RN801-RN803; the 25 mm run to J801.11 is the MCU-to-display distance
TP803: display-frame GND test pad: position set by the display frame mechanics
TP801: display-frame GND test pad: position set by the display frame mechanics
TP1102: pogo test pad on USB_DM: position set by the display frame / pogo dongle mechanics; it sits on the D- route 5.2 mm from J1101.A7, no stub
R1505: EXP_VHP_SNS divider top (100 k) at the rail end, 5.2 mm from J1201.21: the long run to U401.17 carries only the divided node, never the raw shield rail (sensitivity.json routing rule)
R1506: EXP_3V3_SNS divider top (100 k) at the rail end, 1.0 mm from C1503: the long run to U401.18 carries only the divided node
R1212: EXP_I2C_SCL 2.2 k pull-up, left at its pre-cp4 spot when the U1201 cluster moved (its twin R1211 sits at U1201). The spot at U1201 is copper-blocked: the SCL / SDA F.Cu pair passes U1201.7 at 0.22 mm pitch with R1211 beside it, so no via fits. Electrically neutral: a 12 mm open-drain stub at <= 400 kHz (rise >= 300 ns). Optional hand clean-up: docs/LEAD_GUI_STEPS.md
D803: NSI45020A backlight constant-current regulator: anywhere on the cathode line, and the four CCRs D801-D804 are spread for heat (about Vak x 20 mA each), per its sensitivity rule
R808: MARK_N 1 k series resistor at the MCU end (7.4 mm from U401.3) to limit button ESD current into the pin; the 41 mm run to SW802 is the button-to-MCU distance, not the resistor's
U301: SHT40 in-box humidity / temperature sensor: 3 mm from the south board edge, 28 mm from the charger U1101 (heat), 1.0 mm from its decoupling cap C301 and 3.5-4.3 mm from U1201 on the I2C bus; the audit's saving is towards far I2C partners
R302: I2C_SCL pull-up at the MCU bus end (3.2 mm from U401.95), 41 mm from U302 (self-heating rule >= 5 mm); the saving is 3.7 mm
R301: I2C_SDA pull-up at the MCU bus end (3.8 mm from U401.96), 48 mm from U302 (self-heating rule >= 5 mm); the saving is 4.6 mm
R601: +3V3_SD 1 ohm isolation resistor at the load end (1.1 mm from U601.17), so the filtered node with C601 stays local to the SD socket; the +3V3_D side is the feed
R809: Q802 gate resistor of the slow backlight high-side switch, 1.5 mm from R810 and 2.9 mm from Q802.1; the 3.7 mm saving would re-route a finished cluster
C1103: VBUS 1 uF hot-plug cap 3.8 mm from J1101.A9 / B4, inside its 5 mm datasheet budget, with D1101; the audit's spot is not copper-legal (query.py free --copper: nearest legal spot 7.8 mm from it)
C1113: BQ25798 SYS 0.1 uF at the north end of U1101's west pin column (pins 25-29 at x 143.10), on F.Cu with a GND via in the pad and a 0.5 mm feed, as in TI Fig. 8-21. SW801 / SW802 (pins 26 / 28) leave west between C1113 and C1108, so the cap cannot sit beside pin 25. 2.29 mm pad gap; the 0.6 mm courtyard slack left would give 1.69 mm, still over the 1.5 mm, which is EMC practice, not a datasheet number. Known minor deviation: the SYS 10 uF bulk C1114 sits closer (1.88 mm) than this 0.1 uF, against TI Table 5-1 '0.1 uF closest'; optional hand swap in docs/LEAD_GUI_STEPS.md
C1108: BQ25798 PMID 0.1 uF at the south end of U1101's west pin column, courtyard touching U1101's (closest legal pose), on F.Cu with a GND via in the pad and a 0.5 mm feed, as in TI Fig. 8-21. 1.69 mm pad gap against 1.5 mm EMC practice (datasheet: 'on top of the IC, short traces')
C508: REF5030 VIN 100 nF: the nearest part to U503 pin 2 (2.10 mm against 2.0 mm, 0.1 mm over); GND pad in the F.Cu GND fill plus a GND via 1.09 mm away (datasheet 9.3: as close as possible)
U1102: TPD4E05U06 USB ESD on B.Cu, 3.69 mm from J1101.A5: J1101's shell region allows no foreign copper (P1-7, rule v11_j10_shell_no_foreign_F and the K12_J10 keep-outs), so U1102 sits at its edge, next to D1101, with flow-through routing (TI 7.4.1)
